Endocrine surgery treats disorders of the hormone-producing glands, mainly the thyroid, parathyroid and adrenal glands, when too much or too little hormone is produced or when a growth needs removal. These delicate operations require careful technique to protect the voice, calcium balance and surrounding structures. MedLuxLife arranges your consultation with the surgical team at our partner hospital and plans your stay around surgery and recovery; hormone results and scans go directly to the doctors.

MedLuxLife arranges a consultation with an endocrinologist at our partner hospital and coordinates any further tests or treatment.

Excessive hair growth in women, known as hirsutism, is usually a sign of an underlying condition rather than a disease in itself, and its causes range from polycystic ovary syndrome to, more rarely, tumours. The clinic at our partner hospital takes a multidisciplinary approach to identifying the cause and planning suitable treatment. MedLuxLife arranges a discreet, well-prepared visit and coordinates every step of your stay.

Exosomes are tiny vesicles released by cells that carry proteins, lipids and growth signals. For hair restoration they are usually derived from mesenchymal stem cells and injected into thinning areas of the scalp, where they stimulate the follicles, extend the growth phase and support a healthier scalp. Exosomes are often combined with PRP.

Exosomes deliver growth factors and proteins to skin cells to support regeneration and collagen production. Applied after microneedling, laser or radiofrequency treatments, they help the skin recover and look brighter, firmer and smoother.

Gastroenterological surgery is the surgical specialty for diseases of the digestive tract, from the mouth to the anus, when medication or endoscopic treatment is not enough. At our partner hospital, surgeons with subspecialty training in this field work closely with gastroenterologists on diagnosis and treatment planning. MedLuxLife coordinates the review of your endoscopy, imaging and pathology results so that a surgical opinion can be given before you travel.

The department at our partner hospital offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, alongside dedicated care for reflux, liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer screening. MedLuxLife helps you arrange procedures and understand preparation instructions; the hospital gives you your reports for your doctor at home.
Gastroenterology handles diagnosis and endoscopic procedures, while the surgical team takes over when an operation is needed, supporting a joined-up plan.

General surgery covers the evaluation and operative treatment of a broad range of conditions affecting the digestive tract, abdominal organs, breast, endocrine glands and soft tissues. MedLuxLife connects you with professional healthcare and carefully plans every step of your journey. Whether you are looking for an aesthetic or dental treatment or for specialist hospital care, we help you find the right specialists, prepare your treatment and organise your stay.
MedLuxLife is based in Aachen, Germany.

MedLuxLife was founded by Anna and Emrah in Aachen, Germany. We bring two things together: medical treatment with qualified specialists at our partner clinics and hospitals in Türkiye – and travel to any destination you choose, whether a holiday, a city break, a business trip or a pilgrimage.

Medical aesthetics offers non-surgical treatments to smooth lines, restore volume and refresh the skin, with little or no downtime. Treatments are carried out by qualified doctors and planned to keep your natural expression.
Medical and surgical treatment of gynaecological cancers
Medical assessment of weight-related metabolic problems, insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome, with referral to nutrition or obesity surgery where suitable.

Medical genetics diagnoses inherited and non-inherited conditions caused by changes in genes, and helps individuals and families understand their risks, including carrier status and risks for future children. The genetic diagnosis centre at our partner hospital offers genetic consultations and counselling alongside cytogenetic, molecular cytogenetic and molecular genetic testing in ISO 15189 accredited laboratories. MedLuxLife coordinates your appointments and the practical steps of your visit.

Medical histology and embryology studies the microscopic structure of the human body and its development before birth, at the level of cells, tissues and organs. As an academic discipline within our partner hospital, it adds scientific depth to the understanding of normal structure and of developmental abnormalities. Medical imaging underpins the diagnosis and treatment planning of many conditions. The imaging unit at our partner hospital brings together radiology and nuclear medicine specialists with a broad range of modern equipment and fully digital reporting. Medical microbiology provides the laboratory testing behind the diagnosis and treatment of infections. The laboratories at our partner hospital support inpatient, outpatient and emergency care across bacteriology, virology, parasitology, mycology, molecular microbiology and infection immunology, with a broad and regularly updated test panel. MedLuxLife coordinates sample collection during your visit and ensures your results are translated and shared with your doctors.

Nephrology is the branch of internal medicine concerned with kidney health and disease, including blood pressure, fluid and electrolyte balance, and the effects of other illnesses and medicines on the kidneys. At our partner hospital, nephrologists provide outpatient, inpatient and intensive care services, all forms of dialysis and assessment for kidney transplantation with lifelong follow-up. MedLuxLife coordinates your appointments and treatment schedule and organises the practical details of your stay.

Neurology focuses on disorders of the brain, spinal cord, nerves and muscles in both adults and children. Through our partner hospital, MedLuxLife arranges access to specialised neurology units, from stroke and epilepsy care to sleep and balance disorders. We coordinate your appointments, translate your records and stay at your side throughout diagnosis and follow-up.
Neuropsychological assessment plus EEG, EMG and transcranial magnetic stimulation, a neurocognitive laboratory and intraoperative imaging and monitoring methods.

MedLuxLife coordinates referrals, scan appointments and the transfer of results to your treating doctors.

Organ transplantation can offer a new perspective to patients with end-stage organ failure. Orthopaedics and traumatology deal with the diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of problems of the bones, joints, muscles and spine in adults and children, including injuries from daily life and sport. Our partner hospital combines experienced orthopaedic surgeons with robotic and navigation technology and works with physical therapy and rehabilitation for a quick return to daily life.

Paediatric cardiology looks after the heart and circulation of children from birth through adolescence. Specialists assess congenital and acquired heart conditions and plan treatment together with paediatric heart surgeons and other specialties. MedLuxLife arranges examinations and follow-up at our partner hospital and supports families during every visit.

Paediatric endocrinology covers hormonal, growth and metabolic disorders in children from the newborn period to 18 years. Treatment is planned with each child’s growth and stage of development in mind. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, tests and follow-up appointments with specialists at our partner hospital.
Paediatric gastroenterologist explaining a digestive system model to a smiling boy and his mother

Paediatric haematology covers blood disorders and childhood cancers from the newborn period to 18 years, with diagnosis and treatment adapted to children. The department works closely with the paediatric bone marrow transplantation clinic for both outpatient and inpatient care. MedLuxLife coordinates assessments, treatment schedules and family logistics at our partner hospital.
Paediatric hepatology care for liver and gallbladder conditions, and evaluation of pancreatic disorders.

Paediatric nephrology deals with diseases of the kidneys, urinary tract, bladder and urethra in children from birth to 18 years. Signs such as swelling of the hands, feet or eyes, blood in the urine or pain when passing urine should be assessed without delay. MedLuxLife arranges specialist consultations at our partner hospital, where care is multidisciplinary and families are supported at every stage.
Paediatric neurologist doing a playful finger test with a smiling boy, brain MRI on the monitor

Paediatric neurology diagnoses and treats disorders of the brain, spinal cord, nerves and muscles in children from birth to 18 years. Early assessment can be important for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning, supported by tests such as MRI and EEG where needed. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, investigations and follow-up at our partner hospital.

Paediatric oncology focuses on the diagnosis, treatment and long-term follow-up of cancers in children and adolescents up to the age of 18, including solid tumours, lymphomas and leukaemias. Childhood cancers behave differently from adult cancers and call for care designed around young patients and their families. MedLuxLife coordinates assessments and treatment at our partner hospital, helping families with records, appointments, travel and communication throughout the course of care.

Paediatric rheumatology covers the assessment, diagnosis and treatment of inflammatory and rheumatic conditions in childhood, which can affect the joints, muscles, blood vessels and skin as well as other organ systems. Because these conditions often differ from their adult forms, care is planned with a multidisciplinary approach. MedLuxLife arranges consultations and follow-up at our partner hospital and supports families throughout their stay.

Paediatric surgery deals with conditions requiring surgical care in infants, children and adolescents, from the prenatal period up to the age of 18. Treatment is tailored to the child’s age and development, with open, endoscopic and laparoscopic techniques available. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, surgery dates and aftercare at our partner hospital, so that families can focus on their child.
